subject: Initial engage — weekzero POC scheduling & owners
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Grant <alicia@solarihealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial engage — weekzero POC scheduling & owners

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. We want to lock a short week-zero kickoff to align success criteria, owners, and timeline before the POC. Suggested agenda (30–45m):
- Introductions + roles (AE / SE / Customer eng / Procurement / Security)
- Success criteria & acceptance gates
- Timeline and responsibilities (who owns test data, access, infra)
- Next steps & artifacts (SOW, SOC2, questionnaire)

Two things from our side: Marissa (AE) will lead success criteria and customer-facing coordination; Dylan (SE) will run the technical kickoff. Can you confirm availability for any 45m slot next week (11/23–11/27) in your timezone? If that week is tight for procurement/security, we can aim for the week after.

I attached a short acceptance criteria template we use to speed alignment.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this set.

Best,
Karthik
Director, Solutions 
Redwood Inference

Karthik —

Thanks for the note. Week of 11/23 is a corporate holiday window for many folks here; procurement and security are thin. Can we please target 11/30–12/4 instead?

A couple requests from our side:
- Please include our security lead (Jack CC'd) and our procurement alias in the invite; they need the SOC2 summary and any data-handling notes up front.
- If you have an SOW draft and an NDA/DocuSign link, send them so procurement can triage prior to the kickoff.

Proposed first-pass: Tue, 12/1 at 10:00 AM ET (45m) — does that work for your team?

Appreciate it,
Alicia
Director of Product
Solari Health

Karthik —

Procurement here. We reviewed the SOW draft and have a couple of quick asks prior to the kickoff so our legal and security teams can clear the meeting outcomes:
1) Please provide the SOC2 summary and any third-party subprocessors list (we got the SOC2-readme-stub.txt but need the formal attestation if available).
2) Share a short security questionnaire (or a link to your shared drive with the questionnaire answers).
3) Provide a DocuSign NDA link for signature; we try to get that in place before technical walkthroughs.

If you can share these items today, we should be able to attend the 12/1 slot. Otherwise we may need to push a day or two.

Procurement Team
Solari Health

Karthia (cc'd recipients) —

We can confirm Tue, 1 Dec 2026 at 10:00 AM ET for a 45m kickoff. Attendees: Alicia (Product), Jack (Security), Procurement alias, Marissa (AE), Dylan (SE), Karthik (Director). Please send calendar invite and include the short acceptance criteria in the invite body. A couple quick acceptance bullets we want on the kickoff:
- Proof that inference calls succeed end-to-end against a synthetic dataset (no PHI)
- Agreement on who will own retention / logs for the POC duration
- Rolling schedule for the 2-week POC with checkpoints (Day 3 technical validation, Day 10 end-of-PoC review)

We've received the SOW draft and SOC2 stub; we'll review and send any redlines before the meeting. Thanks for getting the NDA link in advance.

See you on Dec 1 — Alicia
